intent: Decouple verified PDF source identity and claim-relevant readable content from optional raw-byte materialization across source persistence and research execution, so transport friction does not block historical research while preserving claim-scoped Evidence integrity and one logical document identity.
rationale: CAP-0001 already owns source identity/preservation, CAP-0002 owns claim-level Grounded Evidence, and CAP-0007 owns bounded execution composition. The observed failure was downloader/source-pack coupling across those stages. Extend the existing owners: locator-only remains below Evidence, content-verified readable representations may persist document versions without claiming raw materialization, and orchestration v2 verifies transport-neutral prepared material rather than requiring a Release pack.
